settings.heading: Dr. Angela (Niki) Serravalle
settings.subheading: Psy.D., LPCMH, NCC · Founder and Licensed Psychologist

settings.heading: A trauma-based psychologist, educator, and writer.
settings.body:
Dr. Angela (Niki) Serravalle is a licensed psychologist and licensed professional counselor, an EMDR Certified Therapist and Approved Consultant, and the founder of Center for Balanced Living. Her clinical work centers on trauma, psychological evaluation, and professional training.

She is the founder of the CFBL Institute, providing continuing education for licensed clinicians, and of MUSA, a publication of essays and longer-form writing on psychology and being human.
